title: Course Metadata: 2301101T
text_snippet: Course: Calculus and Differential Equations (2301101T). Credits: 3. Academic Year: 2023-2024. Revision: 2.0. Teaching Scheme: Lecture hours: 3/week, IA: 30, MSE: 20, ESE: 50, Total Marks: 100. Prerequisite: NIL.

title: CEO: 2301101T.CEO.1
text_snippet: Course Objective 2301101T.CEO.1: To apply the concepts of partial differentiation.

title: CEO: 2301101T.CEO.2
text_snippet: Course Objective 2301101T.CEO.2: Demonstrate an understanding towards the applications of partial differentiation.

title: CEO: 2301101T.CEO.3
text_snippet: Course Objective 2301101T.CEO.3: Examine methods for solving first-order first-degree ordinary differential equations.

title: CEO: 2301101T.CEO.4
text_snippet: Course Objective 2301101T.CEO.4: Infer the applications of first-order differential equations.

title: CEO: 2301101T.CEO.5
text_snippet: Course Objective 2301101T.CEO.5: Determine the solution of linear differential equations of second and higher order.

title: CEO: 2301101T.CEO.6
text_snippet: Course Objective 2301101T.CEO.6: Solve first-order linear and nonlinear partial differential equations.

title: CO: 2301101T.CO.1
text_snippet: Course Outcome 2301101T.CO.1: Make use of properties of partial differentiation to solve the problems [L3].

title: CO: 2301101T.CO.2
text_snippet: Course Outcome 2301101T.CO.2: Examine the applications of partial differentiation [L4].

title: CO: 2301101T.CO.3
text_snippet: Course Outcome 2301101T.CO.3: Solve first-order and first-degree ordinary differential equations [L3].

title: CO: 2301101T.CO.4
text_snippet: Course Outcome 2301101T.CO.4: Analyze real-world phenomenon governed by first-order ordinary differential equations [L4].

title: CO: 2301101T.CO.5
text_snippet: Course Outcome 2301101T.CO.5: Apply concepts of solving linear differential equations of second and higher order governing different systems in engineering [L4].

title: CO: 2301101T.CO.6
text_snippet: Course Outcome 2301101T.CO.6: Determine solutions of various partial differential equations by theoretical methods [L3].
